summary: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC Anniversary/Master Collection route with exact expansion scope documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with exact expansion, fix, and multiplayer/community state documented

primary.version: Current Steam/GOG PC route with expansion/bundle state documented
primary.why: The PC release is the core RTS route, and completeness depends on whether the archive includes only the base campaign or also Winter Assault, Dark Crusade, and Soulstorm. Current PC bundles/Anniversary Edition improve access, but expansion ownership and multiplayer/community state must be recorded.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release. Record storefront/build, base versus expansion campaign, Anniversary/Master Collection or individual ownership, resolution/fix state, mods, skirmish/multiplayer server state, faction, difficulty, and whether later Dawn of War sequels were excluded.

secondary.exclusive_content: Winter Assault, Dark Crusade, and Soulstorm campaigns/factions
secondary.what_to_play: Include only when documenting the complete Dawn of War 1 era.
secondary.why: They substantially expand content and should be labeled rather than folded into the base game silently.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge Dawn of War II/III into this entry; document base versus expansion scope.
